column7: Mission Bay School, the neighborhood’s first public school campus, held its grand opening on Aug 6, 2026, and the SF Chronicle reported that nearly 200 students arrived for its first day of class on Monday, Aug 17; Block 12 West, the last remaining development parcel in Mission Bay South, is the subject of a proposed OCII memorandum of understanding that an Aug 13, 2026 advisory committee item showed as not yet approved and that was on the OCII Commission's Oct 6, 2026 agenda (item 5(c)); no source read reports the outcome of that vote.
column9: DataSF, Former San Francisco Redevelopment Agency Project Areas (dataset m288-24sn), features 'Mission Bay - North' and 'Mission Bay - South'; OCII, Mission Bay South overview (sfocii.org/projects/mission-bay-south/overview), for the area's description
column12: The official Mission Bay North and South project areas of San Francisco's former Redevelopment Agency. OCII describes Mission Bay North as lying between Townsend Street and the Mission Creek Channel, from 3rd Street to 7th Street, and Mission Bay South as running from the channel south to Mariposa Street and from Interstate 280 east to the Bay.
